messages:
sam: Quick sync: FjordML wants a short POC to validate latency and burst behavior for a conversational embedding+rerank flow. They specifically asked for sustained qps, p99 tail, and cold-start impact. Can we outline a minimal run plan for Tue AM?

leah: Tue morning works for ops. What targets are they expecting?

sam: They want mixed traffic: ~70% chat, 30% embed. Sustained 300 qps for ~20-25m, with 3 microbursts to 1200 qps (~30s each). Goals: p95_chat <= 250ms, p95_embed <= 400ms.

mike: Couple clarifying points: 1) model variant (quantized vs fp16) for cost estimates? 2) will they accept a dedicated run (we'll use Dedicated pool) vs hosted? 3) include client retry behaviour?

zara: Recommend testing with 70b-quant for fidelity, and a secondary run with 13b to show tradeoffs. Bursts will affect KV cache hit rate; include warmup phase.

sam: FjordML prefers 70b. They also want to see effect of enabling prefix caching and our automatic batching. Include two configs: baseline (no cache, batching off) and optimized (cache + batching).

solutions-eng: Plan: run two sequential experiments. Run1 (cold): fresh workers, no cache, batching=min. Run2 (warm): pre-prime cache for 10m, batching=auto. Each experiment: 25m steady-state at 300 qps, three 30s microbursts at 1200 qps spaced ~5min apart. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU util, batch size histogram, and kv_cache_hit ratio.

ops-bot: deploy-bench-run initiated by solutions-eng — id=run-4932109876-1

mike: Please instrument traces with labels: route=(chat|embed), model_variant, batch_size, kv_hit, client_retry_count, request_tokens. Also export client-side timestamps to separate network vs server latency.

jordan: Security flags from FjordML: need confirmation on log retention (<=7d), KMS integration for customer keys, and SCIM SSO for console access. Also a short note on tenancy / egress controls.

leah: We support customer-managed KMS in Private, SCIM SSO, and can set log retention policies. I'll draft a short security summary to attach.

zara: Quick load snippet for the embed path (vegeta):

```
echo '{"input":"<long doc>"}' | vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=25m | vegeta report
```

sam: Also run a variant without client retries so we can see raw server behavior, and one with exponential-backoff to simulate their SDK.

solutions-eng: Preliminary results (summary):
Run1 (cold, no cache): p50_chat=125ms, p95_chat=490ms, p99_chat=1.02s, p95_embed=890ms, avg_batch=1.6, GPU_util=60% avg
Run2 (warm, cache+batching): p50_chat=88ms, p95_chat=205ms, p99_chat=430ms, p95_embed=310ms, avg_batch=5.4, GPU_util=80% avg
Bursts: Run1 showed initial tail amplification during the first 10s of each microburst (~1.5-2x p95). Run2 absorbed bursts with only small transient increases.

mike: Nice. That shows caching + batching reduce tail significantly (roughly 2x for chat p95 and ~2.8x for embed p95). We'll make charts.

jordan: Cost question from FjordML: can we provide rough per-1M-token cost comparisons for cold vs warm configs?

leah: Ballpark: cold is ~ $X per 1M tokens due to lower batching efficiency; warm is roughly 0.7X per 1M. I'll compute precise numbers after extracting token counts from traces.

sam: Customer asks for a short doc covering: test plan, observed metrics, cost estimate, security notes, and reproducer steps. Any blockers to shipping that?

solutions-eng: No blockers. Deliverable: 1-page summary + 2 slide charts + runbook snippet. Target: EOD Monday.

mike: I'll own charts + exact cost calc. jordan take security summary. leah draft runbook and vegeta scripts. sam will lead customer readout.

sam: Great — ping me in #sales if anything urgent pops. :thumbsup:
